primary.why: Containment Breach is a freeware SCP horror game whose archive state depends on exact version, launcher/source, mods, and whether multiplayer remakes or Unity ports are excluded. The original Blitz3D/PC build is the named-game route.
primary.how_to_play: Use the official/preserved Windows build. Record version, source, OS/fix state, launcher/options, seed/difficulty, save behavior, mods, SCP wiki/content license context, and whether SCP: Secret Laboratory or Unity remakes were only referenced.

secondary.why: They are not the original Containment Breach route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Version, mods, random seed, and remake/multiplayer branches materially change the experience.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not substitute SCP: Secret Laboratory or Unity fan remakes.
